standard_prerequisites.name: The simplicial-site situation and augmentations of sites
standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 1988-1991: a_0 is an augmentation towards a site D as in the remark, giving the topos morphism a with pushforward a_* and component pushforwards a_{n,*} on the total site C_total.

standard_prerequisites.name: The simplicial resolution attached to an augmentation
standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 1928-1943: for any abelian sheaf G on D there is an exact complex ... -> g_{2!}(a_2^{-1}G) -> g_{1!}(a_1^{-1}G) -> g_{0!}(a_0^{-1}G) -> a^{-1}G -> 0 of abelian sheaves on C_total; applied here via Hom(-, F).

core_obligations: Yoneda reduction (proof lines 2002-2009): by the Yoneda lemma it suffices to construct, functorially in the abelian sheaf G on D, the complex 0 -> Hom(G, a_*F) -> Hom(G, a_{0,*}F_0) -> Hom(G, a_{1,*}F_1) -> ...; this is obtained by applying Hom(-, F) to the exact complex of the simplicial resolution lemma and using adjointness of pullback and pushforward (identifying Hom(G, a_{n,*}F_n) with the Hom against the corresponding resolution term).
Exactness in degrees -1, 0 (lines 2010-2013): follows from the construction, as Hom(-, F) is left exact.
Injective case (lines 2013-2017): if F is an injective abelian sheaf, then Hom(-, F) is exact and the complex is exact everywhere.
proof_roadmap: Reduce the construction of the complex to its Hom values via the Yoneda lemma.
Obtain the Hom complex from the simplicial resolution by applying Hom(-, F), using adjointness.
Read off the exactness statements from left exactness, resp. exactness, of Hom(-, F).
difficulty_reason: Construction lemma (statement 1987-2000, proof 2002-2017): builds the canonical pushforward complex 0 -> a_*F -> a_{0,*}F_0 -> ... on D by a Yoneda reduction to the Hom complex, sourced from the chapter's simplicial resolution lemma via Hom(-, F) and adjointness; the two exactness statements follow from left exactness, resp. exactness, of Hom(-, F); no verification is omitted. H2: Yoneda bookkeeping over an established resolution.
